prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Your new pet is now roaming your desktop. Use system tray icons to hide, summon, or talk to your companion anytime."]
1: ["Choose Your Companion's Personality & Form", "Select a visual style and personality trait to shape how your desktop pet interacts with you.", "Select Companion Archetype"]
2: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "Synthesizing graphics, desktop behaviors, and AI personality traits...", "Creation Progress"]
3: []
4: ["Signing in ensures your created pet and customizations are permanently saved to your account."]
5: ["Verifying desktop overlay permissions and initializing companion display engine..."]
6: ["Pet Generation Complete!", "Click to place your companion on your desktop."]
7: ["How Would You Like to Adopt?", "Choose Instant Adoption to pick a ready-to-play pet in seconds, or Custom Creator to generate a unique companion."]
8: ["Includes Starter Toy & Treat Pack"]
9: ["Discover Your Desktop Companion", "Explore Adoption Paths"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions bundled extras or free items
